```plato
    // Lame's first parameter, lambda: the coupling between one normal strain
    // and the normal stresses along the other two axes. It has no independent
    // physical reading of its own; it is the constant that makes the isotropic
    // stress-strain law a two-term formula.
    FirstLameParameter(m: EngineeringMaterial): Pressure
        => Pressure(m.YoungsModulus.Pascals * m.PoissonRatio
            / ((1.0 + m.PoissonRatio) * (1.0 - 2.0 * m.PoissonRatio)));
```
